half_unit.fee_note: Unconfirmed: 14000 toman is used conservatively for the half unit too, until the broker confirms whether the half-unit fee is 7000 or 14000.

price_offset_note: DaryaGold minus Dukascopy bid. Calibrated 2026-11-13 15:37 Tehran from the DaryaGold 1m chart: lows 3886.6 vs bid 3886.28, highs 3897.6 vs 3897.29; uncertainty about ±0.5.
news_buffers_note: Effective window is the stricter (union) of these floors and the stored start/end in data/news_windows.json. Stored windows are never shrunk or rewritten.

session.note: DaryaGold follows forex/gold hours (Sun 18:00 NY open to Fri 17:00 NY close, DST-aware). Overnight weekday holds are allowed; there is no daily 22:30/00:30 cutoff. Friday only: no new entries from 2 hours before 17:00 NY (23:30 Tehran in US winter) and all trades must be closed before Friday 17:00 NY (01:30 Tehran in US winter).
